name: Cedar Crossing Main Street
description: Two blocks of brick storefronts, a blinking courthouse clock, and more opinions than parking spaces.

name: Dottie's All-Night Diner
description: A chrome-edged diner where the coffee is strong and the jukebox sometimes plays songs that have not been written.

name: Miller's North Field
description: A square mile of corn, windbreaks, and suspiciously geometric cow behavior.

name: County Road 9
description: A straight rural road that occasionally takes liberties with distance, time, and roadside signage.

name: Bramley Grain Elevator
description: A corrugated tower, rail spur, and office ledger that recently acquired a quiet metallic heartbeat.

name: Old Meteorology Station
description: A decommissioned weather station filled with cracked instruments that still point to incoming events.

name: Cedar Creek Chapel
description: A small roadside chapel with a bell that rings whenever something above the clouds gets embarrassed.

name: County Library Basement
description: Archive shelves, microfiche cabinets, and a boiler room wall marked with pencil notes from prior strange weeks.

name: The Orchard Sink
description: A shallow depression behind an abandoned apple orchard where compasses point politely downward.

name: All-Hours Gas and Bait
description: A gas station at the highway split, selling minnows, motor oil, and a surprising number of emergency blankets.

name: Pell Civic Hall
description: A municipal hall with folding chairs, bad acoustics, and one locked records room that keeps changing door numbers.

name: Hayward Quarry
description: An abandoned limestone quarry where still water reflects constellations not visible overhead.
